This is a game of Werewolf with 5 players: 1 Seer, 1 Werewolf, 1 Possessed, and 2 Villagers. Participants: Takumi, Ryuji, Shunichi, Victoria and Daisuke. Each player's role is secret.

- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Daisuke, Victoria, Shunichi, Takumi and Ryuji. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day). An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

| Day | Start of the day | Talk | End of the day | Night |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | nothing | 4 turns | no vote | the Seer divines one other living player; no attack |
